term: terminal cluster, full collapse and language collapse
resolution: A terminal component is an accessibility fact, not the assertion that its worlds satisfy MC. Full-predicate MC makes every successor identical to the root by the imported K law, so a full-collapsed cluster is singleton. The paired right/twin terminal cluster instead has MC only relative to its fixed two-atom language and fails world extensionality for that domain. The unpaired configuration has language extensionality and still refutes possible MC implies actual MC. All predicates satisfy world extensionality independently of the finite model. No identity follows from agreement on only a finite corpus inventory.
